text: گر بن گت نہیں—شاہ بن پت نہیں۔
romanized: Gur bin gat nahīṅ—Shāh bin pat nahīṅ.
literal_en: Without a religious teacher there is no salvation, without a banker there is no respect.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
